title: The 12 Best Pressure Cookers
metaDescription: Our 12 picks for pressure cookers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pressure cookers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker 6-Quart
strengths: 14 one-touch programs covering soup, beans, meat, rice, steam, slow cook, and yogurt
Widely documented, the most recipes, guides, and community support of any pressure cooker
Keep-warm holds food at temperature for up to 10 hours
limitations: Reaches only 10 to 12 PSI vs. stovetop 15 PSI, slightly longer cook times
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Fissler Vitaquick Pressure Cooker 6.3-Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 15 PSI, German made, Stovetop.
strengths: 15 PSI, the highest standard pressure for the fastest cook times
German-made stainless steel with lifetime durability expectations
Lighter than All American at comparable capacity

products.name: All American 921 21.5-Quart Pressure Cooker/Canner
products.blurb: Key specs: 21.5-quart, Pressure canning, Metal-to-metal seal.
strengths: No rubber gasket, metal-to-metal seal that never degrades or needs replacement
The standard for pressure canning low-acid foods (green beans, meat, stock)
USA made with a multi-decade lifespan

products.name: Instant Pot Duo Plus 9-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker
strengths: Adds programs beyond the standard Duo

products.name: Ninja Foodi 8-Quart Pressure Cooker and Air Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: Pressure + air fry, 8-quart, TenderCrisp.
strengths: Pressure cooks then crisps in the same pot
TenderCrisp approach gives crispy finishes on pressure-cooked meals
limitations: Two lids to manage and store
More complex than a basic pressure cooker

products.name: Kuhn Rikon Duromatic 5-Quart Pressure Cooker
products.blurb: Key specs: Swiss made, 15 PSI, Whisperquiet valve.

products.name: Instant Pot Ultra 10-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-in-1, Altitude adjustment, Dial interface.
strengths: Custom cooking programs with adjustable settings
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: T-fal Clipso Stovetop Pressure Cooker 6.3-Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: T-fal, One-hand open, Stovetop.
strengths: One-hand lid open and close, the most convenient lid system in stovetop pressure cookers
limitations: T-fal gasket replacement required every 2 to 3 years
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Instant Pot Lux 6-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker
strengths: The most affordable entry into the Instant Pot ecosystem
6-in-1 covers pressure cook, slow cook, rice, saute, steam, keep warm

products.name: WMF Perfect Plus Pressure Cooker 6.5-Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: WMF, German made, 15 PSI.

products.name: Breville Fast Slow Pro 6-Quart Pressure Cooker
products.blurb: Key specs: Breville, 11 PSI and 15 PSI, Electric.
strengths: Electric with both 11 PSI and 15 PSI settings, the only electric pressure cooker with a true 15 PSI option

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
